test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Solve the following: (tan θ + sec θ + 1)(cot θ - cosec θ + 1) = ?
solution:
**Given:**

(tan θ + sec θ + 1)(cot θ - cosec θ + 1) = ?

**Formula Used:**

tan θ = sin θ / cos θ

sec θ = 1 / cos θ

cot θ = cos θ / sin θ

cosec θ = 1 / sin θ

**Calculation:**

(tan θ + sec θ + 1)(cot θ - cosec θ + 1)

⇒ (sin θ / cos θ + 1 / cos θ + 1)(cos θ / sin θ - 1 / sin θ + 1)
